# NFL Week 8 - Sun Nov 1

Edge factor ~0.58 applied.

## Picks
- **Dolphins +7 vs Patriots (-110), 0.75u (4:25 PM).** Two AI models favor Miami: Covers AI NE 24-20, SportsLine AI NE 31-28 (MIA +7 pick). Reverse line movement: 83% of tickets / 89% of money on New England, yet the line fell from -8.5 open to -7. Patriots without A.J. Brown and TreVeyon Henderson (plus OL Ben Brown questionable). Miami lost Achane (IR) but Willis led a win over the Jets last week. +7 owns the key number. Dimers (NE 72%) sits on the number. Raw ~58% -> 54.6% vs 52.4%.
- **Rams -6.5 vs Chargers (-110), 0.5u (4:05 PM).** Covers AI LAR 27-17; Dimers Rams 74.4% (~-7.5) with a locked 6.5% edge on this game; Football Nation 27-17. Chargers allow 3.5 sacks/game (31st) and list Alt, McConkey and Derwin James questionable - the same OL-weak-dog spot that sank Chargers +7.5 at KC. Laying 6.5 only; do not lay -7. Small: line already moved 3.5 -> 6.5.

## Leans / passes
- Vikings +3.5 at Lions: Covers AI DET by 2, but line is now 3 with 82% of money on Detroit. Pass at +3.
- Browns +3.5 at Steelers: 89% of money on CLE moved 5.5 -> 3.5, but Covers AI PIT by 7. Split.
- Titans +10.5 at Bengals, Colts +9.5 at Jaguars: Covers AI says dog covers, Dimers on the number. One model each; Tennessee/Indy offenses are the weak links. Pass.
- Bills -3.5, Steelers -3.5: hook through 3. Cowboys -7.5: hook through 7. Pass.
- Chiefs/Broncos: models split. Eagles +6 (McKee backup QB dog). Bears/Seahawks MNF: wait for Monday injury news.

picks.summary: Covers AI and SportsLine AI both have NE winning by 3-4; reverse line move against 89% NE money; NE without A.J. Brown.
Covers AI and Dimers both project Rams by 7.5-10; Chargers OL banged up and allowing 3.5 sacks a game.
